purpose: Guarantee that published Lulea FA results are the exact additive sum of the five municipal simulations rather than a separate independently calibrated sixth forecast.
requiredChecks: FA population equals the sum of all five municipality forecasts in every tested year
FA births, deaths, net migration and scenario effects equal municipal sums
FA population by age and sex equals municipal sums cell by cell
internal scenario redistribution remains net zero on FA level
municipal gross migration is not exposed as FA external gross migration
governance: FA-specific calibrated profiles remain diagnostic and must not drive a separate published FA forecast.
Any change in FA membership requires an explicit config and validation update.
The additive rule applies to baseline and scenario runs.
